title: AWS Launches TorchNeuron Public Beta for Trainium AI Chips
summary:
Amazon Web Services released the TorchNeuron software on October 20 under an Apache 2.0 license to eliminate the need for developers to rewrite PyTorch code when deploying to its custom AI hardware. The tool, launched in public beta, allows for the direct execution of machine learning models on Trainium chips and was introduced during the PyTorch conference.

The open-source transition follows an earlier announcement by AWS that the project would be made public to lower the barriers for developers using Trainium accelerators. By providing open access to the code, AWS provides a tool that integrates the industry-standard PyTorch framework with its proprietary silicon training infrastructure.
